evidence: Ter. Eun. 5.4.17: ex jūre hesternō; Cic. Fam. 9.20.2: jūs fervēns (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The broth or juice of meat; not the same word as jūs, law, though spelled alike.

sources: Lewis & Short: jus
